raw: Agent Name: Planner, Step Number: 9, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly transcribed/swapped the directors’ birth dates—assigning 1986-06-19 to Oscar Barney Finn and 1943-06-09 to Jason Michael Brescia—contradicting the WebSurfer’s sources (Finn: 1938-10-28; Brescia: 1986-06-19), which led to the wrong conclusion that The Newest Pledge’s director was born earlier.
